# === Hold global ops/dev (PERSIST, but assert) ===
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1000, development=300)
nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0)  # keep in-app ads OFF

print("=== APPLIED. Verifying ===")
ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
print("capacity tier now:", ci.get('current_tier', ci))

cash0 = 122553.0
og_c0 = 647.0; a0 = 297.0
P = 229.5; PA = 19.4
bill_frac = {0:0.187, 1:0.299, 2:0.314, 3:0.163, 4:0.161}
afrac = {0:0.35,1:0.30,2:0.29,3:0.05,4:0.28}
def bf(i): return bill_frac.get(i, 0.225)
def af(i): return afrac.get(i, 0.23)
horizons = {1:'wk41(d287)',4:'wk44(d308)',12:'wk52(d364)',26:'wk66(d462)'}

# Decelerating churn-at-billing: start hi, decay toward lo (concentration). compute=$16/C/wk.
def run(ogc_bill_hi, ogc_bill_lo, ac, fixed, comp_per_c, label):
    cash=cash0; ogc=og_c0; a=a0; out={}
    for wk in range(1,27):
        i=wk-1
        frac = wk/26.0
        ogc_bill = ogc_bill_hi*(1-frac)+ogc_bill_lo*frac  # decel
        billed_c=ogc*bf(i); churn_c=billed_c*ogc_bill
        rev_c=(billed_c-churn_c)*P; ogc-=churn_c
        billed_a=a*af(i); churn_a=billed_a*ac
        rev_a=(billed_a-churn_a)*PA; a-=churn_a
        rev=rev_c+rev_a+200
        compute=comp_per_c*ogc+500
        cash+=rev-(compute+fixed)
        if wk in horizons: out[wk]=cash
    print('%-6s' % label, {horizons[h]:round(out[h]) for h in horizons}, '| endOGC=%d'%ogc)
    return out

# fixed = ops7k+dev2.1k+capT2 3.7k = 12.8k
print('=== fixed=$12.8K (T2), compute=$16/C/wk ===')
run(0.22,0.12,0.30,12800,16, 'BASE')   # decel 4.5%->2.6%/wk
run(0.14,0.09,0.20,12800,15, 'BULL')   # 3%->2%/wk
run(0.32,0.20,0.45,12800,17, 'BEAR')   # 6.5%->4.3%/wk
print('=== fixed=$10.6K (T1 from wk41, ops7k+dev2.1k+cap1.5k) ===')
run(0.22,0.12,0.30,10600,16, 'BASE+T1')
